correctness.rationale: Abrams sufficiently-subdivided model applies to Petersen girth 5 with exactly two distinct unordered points. From actual KG(5,2) edge list, independently reconstructed 45 C0,120 C1,75 C2, signed boundaries and d1*d2=0, spanning-tree 44 and 76 chord coordinates. Exact independent elimination gives rank(M mod2)=69, mod3=70, mod5=70 and 70x70 integral minor determinant -2. Hence rational rank=70, all 70-minors even but one ±2 so Smith nonzero factors 69 units and one 2. Independently checked supplied 75x5 integer H2 cycles are in ker(d2), 5x5 pivot det -1; rank ker=5. Thus H1=Z^6⊕Z/2, H2=Z^5, no higher chains. Reconstructed all 120 S5 actions on entire C2 kernel basis, verified every 75-row action, yielding H1/H2 characters by class [6,0,-2,0,0,1,0] and [5,-1,1,-1,1,0,-1], matching Specht (3,1,1) and (2,2,1). Aut(P)=S5 from five maximal K4 cliques of complement. Torsion Z/2 fixed because Aut(Z/2)=1.
